tokoh_utama: A 25-year-old Indonesian male office worker with short black hair, wearing a white button-up shirt with sleeves rolled up, dark navy trousers, and sleek black dress shoes.

part.pertanyaan: Kalian berani lembur sendirian di kantor? Kantor kalian ada cerita serupa?
part.caption: Jangan pernah ke toilet kantor sendirian kalau sudah di atas jam 8 malam... #ceritahoror #hororkantor

adegan.narasi: Di kantorku, bilik toilet paling ujung lantai empat selalu terkunci erat dari dalam.
adegan.gambar: Dimly lit modern office restroom interior, row of wooden toilet stalls, the last stall at the end is firmly closed under a harsh ceiling light.

adegan.narasi: Pak Teguh si OB bilang bilik itu sudah lama rusak dan tidak pernah digunakan.
adegan.gambar: An elderly Indonesian office janitor holding a mop, pointing towards a dark corridor with a subtle warning expression.

adegan.narasi: Malam itu jam delapan pas, aku terpaksa lembur sendirian di kubikel ruang kerja.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist sitting alone at a desk in a spacious empty office room at night, glowing blue laptop screen lighting his face.

adegan.narasi: Notifikasi laptop berbunyi, perutku mendadak mulas karena terlalu banyak minum kopi hitam dingin.
adegan.gambar: Close up of a cold coffee cup on an office desk next to a glowing laptop showing overtime work files.

adegan.narasi: Aku berjalan menyusuri lorong kantor yang terasa makin dingin menuju pintu toilet wanita-pria.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist walking down a narrow grey office hallway at night, fluorescent overhead lights humming quietly.

adegan.narasi: Saat masuk toilet, aku kaget melihat lampu bilik paling ujung menyala sangat terang.
adegan.gambar: Restroom doorway view showing bright yellow light spilling from underneath the last closed toilet stall door.

adegan.narasi: Di bawah celah pintu bilik ujung, terlihat sepasang sepatu kantor pria menghadap ke dalam.
adegan.gambar: Extreme low angle shot under a wooden stall door, showing formal black leather shoes standing pointing inward towards the toilet bowl.

adegan.narasi: Aku berbisik santai pada diri sendiri, "Wah, ternyata ada karyawan lain yang lembur."
adegan.gambar: The protagonist looking at the stall door while entering the neighboring empty stall, looking relieved.

adegan.narasi: Selesai buang air, aku berjalan santai menuju wastafel untuk mencuci tangan yang kotor.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist stepping out of the stall and approaching the porcelain sink under flickering lights.

adegan.narasi: Aku memutar kran air, mendengarkan gemericik air jernih yang terasa sangat dingin mengalir.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist washing hands under running sink water. In the large mirror reflection behind him, the far-end stall door is slightly open showing a tall dark shadowy figure standing inside, but the protagonist is only looking down at his hands.

adegan.narasi: Saat mendongak menatap cermin, mataku tanpa sengaja melirik celah bawah pintu bilik ujung.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of protagonist's shocked reflection in the mirror, eyes wide open looking down towards the background reflection.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku serasa berhenti, sepasang sepatu kantor di bilik itu sekarang sudah berbalik menghadap keluar.
adegan.gambar: Close-up bottom gap of the stall door, the black office shoes are now pointing directly outward toward the sink.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu jadi aku, kamu ketuk bilik itu atau langsung pulang?
part.caption: Misteri lima tahun lalu yang sengaja ditutupi manajemen kantor... #part2 #ceritahoror

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan bilik misterius, keesokan harinya aku masih sangat kepikiran dengan kejadian aneh semalam.
adegan.gambar: Morning sunlight entering the office building lobby, protagonist standing near the reception desk looking pale and tired.

adegan.narasi: Aku nekat mendatangi pos satpam untuk memeriksa buku catatan absensi lembur manual kantor.
adegan.gambar: The security guard desk with dusty binder logbooks, protag searching through old attendance sheets.

adegan.narasi: Mataku teliti menyisir kolom absensi lama dari lembar-lembar kertas yang sudah menguning kusam.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of yellowed paper attendance sheets with handwritten names, dates, and sign-in sign-out times.

adegan.narasi: Ada satu nama mantan karyawan bernama Wisnu yang kolom absen pulangnya tidak pernah terisi.
adegan.gambar: A specific row on the logbook showing the name 'Wisnu' with a sign-in time of 20:00, but the sign-out column is blank.

adegan.narasi: Pak Teguh mendadak berbisik pelan, "Wisnu hilang misterius lima tahun lalu pas lembur sendirian."
adegan.gambar: Pak Teguh the janitor leaning in close to the protagonist, whispering with a serious shadowy face.

adegan.narasi: Rasa penasaranku makin menjadi-jadi, padahal jam dinding kantor sudah menunjukkan pukul sembilan malam.
adegan.gambar: Wall clock inside the office showing 21:00 in dimly lit surrounding workspace.

adegan.narasi: Malam ini aku terpaksa lembur lagi untuk menyelesaikan dokumen laporan bulanan yang menumpuk.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist working frantically on his computer desk, stacks of paper surrounding his workspace.

adegan.narasi: Sebelum kembali ke lantai empat, aku menghampiri papan absensi lembur di dekat tangga.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist walking towards a wooden clipboard hanging on the wall near a dark stairwell entrance.

adegan.narasi: Kertas absensi malam ini terpasang rapi di papan kayu dekat lorong tangga yang gelap.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the clipboard hanging on the wall. In the background stairwell shadow, a tall eerie shadowy human figure with red glowing eyes stands watching, unnoticed by protagonist.

adegan.narasi: Tanganku gemetar hebat saat membaca deretan nama karyawan di kertas absensi malam ini.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist's shaky hand holding the clipboard under weak fluorescent hallway lighting.

adegan.narasi: Di daftar lembur malam ini, namaku tertulis tepat di posisi bawah nama Wisnu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the paper showing 'Wisnu' written first, and directly below it is the protagonist's name.

adegan.narasi: Tulisan namaku dibuat menggunakan tinta merah pudar oleh tulisan tangan yang bukan milikku.
adegan.gambar: Macro view of the protagonist's name written in faded dark red ink with sharp erratic handwriting.

part.pertanyaan: Kira-kira apa yang akan terjadi kalau aku pakai sepatu di bilik itu?
part.caption: Pesan terakhir dari lantai empat kantor... Jangan pernah lembur sendirian! #part3 #ending

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan terror lantai empat, aku nekat berjalan menuju toilet dengan jantung berdebar keras.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist walking cautiously in the dark restroom hallway, clutching his cell phone tightly.

adegan.narasi: Lampu bilik paling ujung masih menyala, memancarkan cahaya kekuningan yang sangat samar-samar.
adegan.gambar: Restroom view focusing on the dim yellow light leaking around the edges of the end toilet stall.

adegan.narasi: Sambil menahan napas, aku memberanikan diri mengetuk pintu kayu bilik itu tiga kali.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist's hand raised, knocking on the dark worn wooden door of the end stall.

adegan.narasi: Suara ketukan menggema kasar di dalam ruangan toilet yang sangat dingin dan membisu.
adegan.gambar: Shot of the empty bathroom mirrors reflecting the back of the protagonist standing right outside the locked stall.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba dari dalam bilik terdengar suara parau berbisik, "Udah boleh pulang belum?"
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the keyhole on the wooden door, pitch blackness visible inside.

adegan.narasi: Gagang pintu bergerak sendiri, lalu pintu bilik perlahan terbuka lebar tanpa ada dorongan.
adegan.gambar: The door handle turning downward by itself, the door slowly swinging open inward into darkness.

adegan.narasi: Di balik pintu yang terbuka, cermin memperlihatkan pantulan sosok berjas lusuh tepat di sampingku.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of open stall door. In the wall mirror reflection, a ghostly pale man in a tattered business suit is standing right beside the protagonist, while in reality the space next to him is empty.

adegan.narasi: Ruangan bilik itu ternyata benar-benar kosong melompong, tidak ada siapa-siapa di dalamnya.
adegan.gambar: Inside view of the stall illuminated by overhead light, empty toilet bowl and clean tiled walls.

adegan.narasi: Namun di atas lantai keramik dingin, tergeletak sepasang sepatu kantor hitam yang baru.
adegan.gambar: High angle shot of a brand new pair of sleek black office dress shoes sitting on the tiled floor of the stall.

adegan.narasi: Aku melotot panik, itu sepatu persis milikku lengkap dengan ukuran nomor kakiku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of protagonist looking down in sheer terror, realizing the shoes are identical to his own pair down to the brand logo.

adegan.narasi: Ponselku bergetar hebat, ada pesan dari nomor asing: "Sepatumu sudah diganti, mau pulang?"
adegan.gambar: Close-up of Smartphone screen in protagonist's hand displaying a WhatsApp text from an unknown number: 'Sepatumu sudah diganti, mau pulang?'

adegan.narasi: Aku lari terbirit-birit ketakutan; kalau lembur, jangan pernah jadi orang terakhir di kantor.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist sprinting down the dark office hallway toward the exit doors in complete panic.
